changelog:

- Covers title writing formulas, cover design principles, gold content structure, six major copywriting formulas (AIDA/PAS/FAB/4P/QUEST/SSS), storytelling, persuasion laws, modular sales copy assembly, and five-step sales copy methods.
- Provides detailed guides for success on platforms like Xiaohongshu, Toutiao, CSDN, WeChat Official Accounts, and Zhihu.
- Includes specialized techniques: golden opening, high-conversion endings, story structure, and compliance requirements.
- Xiaohongshu-specific operational guide available in a dedicated reference file.
